rationale: The tape is a slow full-session fade — price below VWAP ($10.28) and the 9-EMA, sitting in the bottom 5% of the daily range with a risk-off tape (SPY -0.53%, VIXY +1.71%) — but the fresh-short location is poor: we are one cent above the low of day and the last bounce to $10.26 was already absorbed, meaning the easy part of the move is gone and a double-bottom trap is live. A long has no confirming reversal structure (no higher low, no VWAP reclaim), and a short is better taken on a pullback toward VWAP or a low-of-day break with a failed retest rather than an entry at support. With no catalyst, midday hours remaining, a 1M-share float prone to squeezes, and a session already $396 underwater, standing aside is the positive-EV action.
